title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and the translation vector set to [0.0, 0.709, 0.0]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a rectangular loop defined by four lines: the first line runs from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0725, 0.0), the second line extends from (0.0725, 0.0) to (0.0725, 0.041), the third line goes from (0.0725, 0.041) to (0.0, 0.041), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by connecting (0.0, 0.041) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.0725 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to ensure the correct dimensions. Transform this scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.709, 0.0]. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.4963 units to create the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Finally, define a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The resulting part has a length of 0.07254748206529002 units, a width of 0.041036099700611235 units, and a height of 0.4962747314902988 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0725, 0).lineTo(0.0725, 0.041).lineTo(0, 0.041).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.4963)

# Translate the cylinder to the specified position
cylinder = cylinder.translate((0, 0.709, 0))

# Apply the final name
r = cylinder

r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0725, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0725, 0.041) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.041) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular prism
r = r.extrude(0.4963)
